title: First-coordinate Fourier coefficient
statement: For each natural number $q$, form the Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension one greater than the chosen tail dimension: it is $1$ when the tail coordinates lie in the associated Gaussian-threshold upper-tail set, and otherwise equals the first coordinate. Its Fourier coefficient at the singleton frequency consisting of the first coordinate is $1$ minus the mass of that set.
